summary: The RPM installer is deprecated and will be removed in AAP 2.7; in 2.6 it's supported only on RHEL 9.4+ (RHEL 8 dropped, RHEL 10 unsupported), with PostgreSQL 16 and 17 supported for external databases using external backup.
questions: Is the AAP RPM installer deprecated?
Does AAP 2.6 RPM install support RHEL 8?
Can I install AAP 2.6 RPM on RHEL 10?
When will the RPM installer be removed?

answer_card.title: RPM installation in AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- RPM installer is **deprecated** (since 2.5) and will be **removed in 2.7**.
- Supported on **RHEL 9.4+** only; RHEL 8 dropped; RHEL 10 not supported for RPM.
- External PostgreSQL 16/17 supported, with external backup and restore.
